regulation: Uttar Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (Multi Year Tariff for Distribution) Regulations, 2025
note: The sales forecast's growth rate (Reg. 30.2): the compound annual growth of the past seven years, and a year projected at it.

rules.title: Seven-year compound annual growth (sales, consumers or load) of a consumer category

end.note: the seventh year after the start (FY2024-25 for the FY2026-27 petition)

clause.regulation: Uttar Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (Multi Year Tariff for Distribution) Regulations, 2025
clause.excerpt: 30.2 Unless provided otherwise by the Commission, sales forecast shall be based on the past trends in each of the slabs of consumer categories. The Compounded Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of past seven years of sales within each of the slabs of a consumer category as per the audited books of account, or if not available, then provisional accounts, will be considered: …

rules.note: Reg. 30.2 asks for the CAGR within each slab of a category; ESR2 computes it per category (and for consumers and load as well as sales) — the binding checks ESR2's arithmetic as filed

rules.title: A category's next year at its seven-year CAGR
